verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance (Finicity) is a financial-data and payments API platform. It covers account verification, balances, transactions, webhooks for event notifications and an MCP docs toolkit, but it does not host user-authored automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside its product category. Its webhook and OBWMS event subscriptions are notification delivery, not automation workflows, so they do not make this axis applicable.
